recipes.campaign.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-prefill-current
if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then set -- control candidate; fi
for arm in "$@"; do
    export PLOW_HSACO="$root/overlay-$arm"
    /tmp/tp-glm53-merge-review/plowrt serve --assets /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/assets --port 18977 > "$root/server-$arm.log" 2>&1 &
    server=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    ready=0
    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
        if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18977/v1/models > "$root/models-$arm.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
        kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
        sleep 1
    done
    [ "$ready" = 1 ]
    python3 runtime/bench/amd/mla_sparse_aiter/quality.py http://127.0.0.1:18977 "fold-tail-$arm" "$root/quality-$arm.json" --concurrency 8 > "$root/quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18977 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 20 --random-input-len 70000 --random-output-len 700 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$root" --result-filename "serve-$arm.json" > "$root/bench-$arm.log" 2>&1
    kill -TERM "$server"
    wait "$server" || [ "$?" = 143 ]
    trap - EXIT
done
recipes.build.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-prefill-current
for arm in control candidate; do
  tree="$root/$arm-tree"
  PLOW_DECODE_TIERS= PLOW_ROWS_ONLY==interp_prefill_mla_moe bash "$tree/scripts/build_gfx942.sh" "$root/objects-$arm" > "$root/build-$arm.log" 2>&1
 done

limitations: One paired 20-request screen, not the supplied 100-request H200 comparison.
No repeatability estimate; random sampler count affects the request set.
Bitwise primitive qualification covers eight heads, V256, TB8 and split counts 1/2/7.
Segment drains and packet tracing change timing; overlapping body spans are not additive.
Native kernel dispatch leaves stale packet records; only records inside the final chunk are attributed.
Historical qualified and rebuilt control executable sections differ; both serving arms are matched rebuilds.
